<div class="banner">
  <h1 style="text-align: center;">About Me</h1>
</div>

<div class="custom-margins">
I am originally from the San Francisco Bay Area. I obtained my Ph.D. in Cognitive Psychology at UCLA and completed my dissertation on older adults' susceptibility to scams/fraud. Previously, I obtained my B.S. in Neuroscience at Union College, NY. At Union, I also minored in Data Analytics and German. I then obtained my M.A. in Psychology at UCLA. I recently interned at American AgCredit as their 2025 Data Science Intern. I hope to pursue a career in Data Science or UX Research so I can discover insights through data, code and conduct research everyday! In my free time, I love to explore National Parks, read books, and go to concerts. 
</div>
